# When the simd/archsimd CPU feature check is false the array-operator
# vector form takes the scalar successor: the binary keeps scalar adds
# after the guard, and disabling AVX2 still adds correctly.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'simd feature gate needs amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOAMD64=v1

cd m
logos build -o $WORK/exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.addI32x8$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'CALL.*X86Features\.AVX2\(SB\)'
stdout 'VPADDD'
stdout '(?s)X86Features\.AVX2.*ADDL'

env GODEBUG=cpu.avx2=off
logos run .
stdout '^sums ok$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/featuregatefalse

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

//go:noinline
func addI32x8(a, b [8]int32) [8]int32 { return a + b }

func oracleAdd(a, b [8]int32) [8]int32 {
	var r [8]int32
	for i := range a {
		r[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
	return r
}

func main() {
	var a, b [8]int32
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = int32(i*7 - 100)
		b[i] = int32(i*3 + 1)
	}
	if addI32x8(a, b) != oracleAdd(a, b) {
		panic("int32 add mismatch")
	}
	fmt.Println("sums ok")
}
